description: Spec 022 (phase 10, SRD Annex C §C.17, decision 38): the hybrid of the frozen T2's range with the frozen -g1 fused tracker's velocity (theta 180), judged at G8 (G5 against the -g1 IMM, and median range wholly below the fused tracker's) on fresh seed 224 (400,000; its 40,000-scenario test split, generated alone) with realistic bearing error (configs/phase7-ranges.json). Nothing is trained or tuned; seed 211 supplies T2's normalisation.
